title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to consume enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. However, finding recipes rich in iron and folate can be a challenge. In this article, we'll introduce three Vietnamese-inspired recipes that are rich in iron and folate and can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the baby's brain and spinal cord. To enhance iron absorption, it's recommended to combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods, such as lemons, oranges, or bell peppers.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, bell peppers)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, and other seasonings

Grill the chicken in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, bell peppers)
* 1 bell pepper
* Salt, pepper, and other seasonings

Stir-fry the beef in a pan with oil and seasonings for 10 minutes. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and add the bell pepper on top.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Tofu and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g tofu
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, bell peppers)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, and other seasonings

Cook the tofu in boiling water for 10 minutes. Cook the rice and vegetables in boiling water. Mix all the ingredients together and squeeze the lemon on top.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's essential to avoid eating undercooked or raw foods, such as sushi, sashimi, or undercooked meat. Choose iron-rich and folate-rich foods, such as red meat, chicken, fish, and vegetables.

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, helping to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Remember to combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods to enhance iron absorption. To learn more about iron-rich and folate-rich recipes, visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [read more about prenatal nutrition](/blog/prenatal-nutrition).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about prenatal nutrition, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide you with personalized advice and guidance to ensure your health and the health of your baby.
